{{Quote|Shoran has set up another camp a short distance from here.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to Chewbacca|audio=ShoranCamp-converted.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''Shoran's camp''' was a walled settlement on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] run by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Shoran]]. The camp was built during the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] fought between the Wookiee [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] of Alaris Prime and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]. Shoran's camp featured a [[command center]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], several [[prefab shelter]]s, and other buildings for gathering resources. A [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|Jedi holocron]] was found within the camp's walls and was retrieved by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Forces from Shoran's camp also participated in an [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|attack]] on a nearby [[Trade Federation listening array]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Now that we know where Shoran is we can start trading with him.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to Chewbacca|audio=WhereShoranIs.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Alaris_Holocron.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Jedi holocron found in Shoran's camp]]
[[Shoran]]'s camp was one of several [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] bases built on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. The camp was run from a [[command center]] that was surrounded by five [[Farm/Legends|farms]] in its upper section. The upper section of the camp also held a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the north and a [[Power core/Legends|power core]] and an [[ore processing center]] in the west. The midsection of the camp had an [[animal nursery]], two [[prefab shelter]]s, and another power core. Near the entrance at the lower section of the camp there was a [[food processing center]], a [[carbon processing center]], and another prefab shelter. The western side of the camp contained a significant number of [[Tree/Legends|trees]], with a clearing through them leading to a [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|Jedi holocron]].<ref name="GB" />

The entire camp was surrounded by walls, with one gate at the south and another later added on the north eastern stretch. The eastern wall was bordered by a [[Water/Legends|river]]. Another [[Chewbacca's camp|camp]] led by the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was located to the south, and a [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]] belonging to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] was situated in the east. The camp had access to various resources, including significant [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits, [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] creatures, and [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] [[Bush/Legends|bushes]], which were harvested by the nine Wookiee workers residing there.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|Shoran tells me he found something of interest near his camp; a Jedi holocron.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=ShoranFound.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Wookiee_Jedi_base.png|thumb|right|300px|Chewbacca's camp (pictured) was located near Shoran's camp.]]
The camp was built between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> during the Wookiee [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonization]] efforts on Alaris Prime, of which Shoran was a leader. The Wookiees were engaged in a [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] with the Trade Federation, which had launched an [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|illegal]] colonization effort, and the camp was built in what was believed to be a safe area. At Chewbacca's camp, the Wookiee's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], lectured him on the benefit of having allies and instructed him to build a spaceport. After Chewbacca's workers completed the spaceport, the Wookiees were able to access [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] [[HoloNet transceiver/Legends|technology]], which allowed them to find Shoran's camp.<ref name="GB" />

Chewbacca then built [[Corellian HoverFreighter]]s at the spaceport and sent them to Shoran's camp to exchange resources, which Shoran also did. Afterward, Shoran found the Jedi [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] in his camp and informed Jinn, who had Chewbacca build a [[Jedi temple (Alaris Prime)|Jedi temple]] in which to store the device. Jinn also sent his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] into Shoran's camp to retrieve the holocron. After Kenobi passed through the gates of the settlement, Shoran spotted a group of Trade Federation [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] sent by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[LUH-989]] to [[Attack on Chewbacca's camp|attack]] Chewbacca's camp.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Obi-Wan_going_to_Shorans.png|thumb|left|250px|Obi-Wan Kenobi enters Shoran's camp to retrieve the holocron]]
Shoran warned Chewbacca and Jinn of the attack, which Chewbacca and his Wookiee [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] fought off. Afterward, Shoran requested one hundred [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] from Chewbacca to help recover from the attack, a request which Jinn and Chewbacca obliged. In return, Shoran sent ore to Chewbacca's camp. Later, [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] from Shoran's camp discovered the Trade Federation listening array, and Chewbacca suggested that the Wookiees destroy it. One heavy [[bowcaster trooper]] from Shoran's camp began [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|attacking]] the [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry posts]] at the entrance of the array but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the droids [[Security guard/Legends|guarding]] it. Chewbacca's forces, joined Shoran then marched through the camp toward the listening array and destroyed it.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|If you click the diplomacy button on the right corner of the screen you can see Shoran listed as an ally, and the friendless Trade Federation listed as an enemy.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the player|audio=ShoranSpaceport.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Shoran's camp was first mentioned in [[Prima Games]]' [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]]<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', which was released on [[November 11]] of the same year.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The camp appears in the sixth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, titled "Allies and Jedi."<ref name="GB" />

The camp serves as a method of teaching the player the mechanics of working with teams, particularly through the use of spaceports. At the start of the level, only the spaceport is visible to the player, who is instructed to research the HoloNet transceiver at their own spaceport to see the rest of the camp. For most of the level, the camp only has one gate at the south, but after retrieving the holocron, another gate appears in the north-east wall, allowing the player to attack the listening array. Unused audio files from the level portray Shoran assembling forces in his camp in preparation to attack the array, with Jinn suggesting that the player send any newly created units to join them.<ref name="GB" />
